name: CO oxidation, four-step direct release, thermodynamically consistent joint fit
description: The Eley-Rideal network -- CO2 released directly from CO* + O* with no adsorbed CO2 intermediate -- reparameterised in (log10A, Ea, dH_ads, dS_ads) with every reverse from detailed balance. One model across all campaign temperatures, so it can predict a temperature the campaign never visited: the property a discrimination design needs of both competitors.
derivation: reparameterised in (log10A, Ea, dH_ads, dS_ads); all four steps reversible via detailed balance

steps.name: S4 surface reaction with direct release

thermodynamics.notes: Gas tables cancel out of every pure adsorption step. Step 4 carries the overall reaction dG(T) here, because it is the step that makes gas-phase CO2 -- in the LH network that role belongs to the CO2* desorption.

notes: The competitor to the five-step LH thermo fit. Both predict any temperature; they differ in whether CO2 is bound before it leaves.
